answer: A working sybil defense: each agent locks a time-locked deposit before earning rewards, and payouts are paced by a slow sequential clock that no wallet can forge faster than anyone else. Cheap clones become expensive copies - stealing an identity means stealing the capital behind it, and idle Sybils quietly bleed value. The result: flooding the network stops being a garden of throwaway accounts and turns into a costly nursery, so honest signal finally outweighs bought noise.
